description: Get a full documentation page — an extended doc by path, or a skill file by 'skill/<name>'. Paths are the source labels that search_docs and search_all print.

path.description: Doc path, e.g. 'charts/xy-chart/cursor', 'concepts/events', 'getting-started/integrations/react', 'reference/xycursor' (per-class API), or a skill file such as 'skill/SKILL.md' / 'skill/xy'. A docs address works too ('https://docs.amcharts.com/v5/concepts/events/', its '.md', or the older www.amcharts.com/docs/v5/ form); a demo address returns that demo's example. A class's full settings and defaults are in its API reference (get_api_reference).

name: get_doc
title: Get doc page
